verdict.rationale: Jitsu's Functions feature lets you filter, transform, and enrich events with custom JavaScript/TypeScript before they reach a destination, which could be used to implement hashing, masking, or field-level filtering of sensitive attributes, and filtering can be scoped per source/destination connection. However, there is no documentation of built-in PII-specific tooling (e.g., dedicated hash/mask functions, consent-aware field redaction, or per-destination privacy policy UI) — it relies entirely on the privacy team writing custom function code themselves. Missing for 10: explicit PII/hashing/masking primitives or templates, documented per-destination granular privacy controls, and any evidence of built-in consent-based field suppression.
